problem.read: The server didn't answer as expected. Try again.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not see or do this.
problem.offline: No connection to the server. Check the network and try again.
problem.gone: It no longer exists, or it belongs to another company.
problem.write: It was not booked. Try again.
problem.changed: Someone changed the order meanwhile, or its state no longer allows this: it was read again. Check and try again.
problem.invalid: Something in it was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
problem.slowDown: Too many tries at once. Wait a moment and try again.

tile.balanceFailed: The open balances couldn't be read: the count is not known.

terms.title: Written terms
terms.lawPlain: A subcontract (subfornitura) is made in writing, or it is void: the signed terms say the work, its price, the delivery and the payment terms.
terms.validOpen: covers from {from}, with no end date
terms.supersededBody: A later revision replaced it since; it still covers this order’s date.
terms.fileGone: The signed file is no longer there.

held.noFile: No signed file is kept with this revision.
held.notReady: The signed file is not available yet (still being checked).

none.base: No signed written terms with {workshop} cover {date}.
none.draft: Revision {revision} is written and waits for its signature.
none.none: No terms are written with this workshop yet.
none.otherDays: The signed terms cover other days: a new revision is needed for these.

balance.intro: Our material stays ours while the workshop has it. The balance shows what came back inside the garments, what came back unused and what is still out.

empty.title: Nothing sent yet
empty.body: The balance starts with the kit: once material goes to the workshop, each material sent has its line here.

balance.openAfterBack_one: Every piece is back and material is still out on {count} line: book it as used, returned or scrapped (a loss).
balance.openAfterBack_other: Every piece is back and material is still out on {count} lines: book it as used, returned or scrapped (a loss).

flag.SHORT_AT_WORKSHOP: The workshop counted {checked} {uom} of the {sent} sent: {short} short on arrival.
flag.NOT_DECLARED: Goods came back, but the workshop has not declared what it used of this material yet.
flag.RETURN_NOT_BACK: Declared returned {returned} {uom}; {back} came back into our places so far.
flag.BACK_NOT_DECLARED: {back} {uom} came back into our places; the workshop declared {returned} returned.
flag.OPEN_AFTER_BACK: Every piece is back and {open} {uom} is still out: book it as used, returned or scrapped (a loss).

rows.label: What was booked on line {line}
rows.none: Nothing booked yet: the workshop’s declaration comes with the goods back.

held.nothingSent: Nothing was sent yet: the balance starts with the kit.
held.nothingOpen: Nothing is open: every part of the material sent is declared.
held.notDeclared: The workshop has not declared this material yet: book its declaration first.
held.server: The order’s state does not allow it now: read it again.
held.reasonLong: The words are at most 2000 characters.

declare.title: The workshop’s declaration for {number}
declare.intro: What the workshop says of the material we sent: used in the garments, returned unused, scrapped there. Prefilled with what the goods back suggest: check it against the workshop’s papers.
declare.receiptHint: The receipt the declaration came with.
declare.noteHint: Optional; kept with each line it books.
declare.nothingMoves: Nothing moves yet: type at least one quantity.
declare.costFollows: The material cost of {workOrder} follows the moves.

held.number: Line {line}: each quantity is a number of 0 or more, at most 4 decimals.
held.nothing: Declare at least one quantity above 0.

adjust.title: Over- or under-consumption, line {line} {code}
adjust.intro: What the workshop reports after the goods back: more or less used, returned or scrapped than it declared. Each change says why.
adjust.reasonHint: What the workshop reported, in words.
adjust.question: Book the change on line {line}?
adjust.lossHint: What is still open once every piece is back is a loss: book it as used or scrapped.

held.number: Each change is a number (+ or −), at most 4 decimals.
held.nothing: Change at least one quantity (up or down).
held.moreThanSent: Used, returned and scrapped would pass the {sent} {uom} sent.

move.issue: Line {line} {item}: {quantity} {uom} used, issued from the workshop’s place to {workOrder}.
move.giveBack: Line {line} {item}: {quantity} {uom} less used, back from {workOrder} to the workshop’s place.
move.scrap: Line {line} {item}: {quantity} {uom} scrapped, written off at the workshop’s place.
move.unscrap: Line {line} {item}: {quantity} {uom} less scrapped, the scrap taken back at the workshop’s place.
move.returned: Line {line} {item}: {quantity} {uom} returned unused — no move here (the goods back moved it).

refused.period: The day it was reported falls in a closed accounting period: ask the accountant.
refused.reportedAt: The day it was reported is not accepted: not later than now, not before the order was sent.
refused.receipt: That receipt is not one of this order’s.
refused.notDeclared: The workshop has not declared this material yet: book its declaration first.
refused.reason: Say why, in at most 2000 characters.
refused.belowZero: A quantity would go below 0: read the line again.
refused.open: More than is still open: read the line again.

balance.booked_one: Booked: the stock followed with {count} move.
balance.booked_other: Booked: the stock followed with {count} moves.
balance.bookedWaiting_one: Booked: the stock followed with {count} move; the work order’s cost waits (another currency).
balance.bookedWaiting_other: Booked: the stock followed with {count} moves; the work order’s cost waits (another currency).

cost.intro: The fee for the pieces plus material and transport, booked to {workOrder}.
cost.failed: Couldn't load cost to the work order
cost.noGrain: Prices and amounts need the cost grain (money.cost): the pieces are shown, not what they cost.

empty.title: No cost yet
empty.body: Booked when goods come back: the fee for each piece back good goes to the work order.

rung.earnedFee: Fee for the pieces back good

ledger.holds_one: {workOrder}’s cost holds {amount} of this order ({count} entry).
ledger.holds_other: {workOrder}’s cost holds {amount} of this order ({count} entries).
ledger.currency: Order {order} is in {currency}; {workOrder} keeps its cost in {woCurrency} and no exchange rate of the order’s day is kept: nothing posts there yet (keep one in Finance › Settings › Currencies & rates).

op.title: Per operation
op.waitingHint: Pieces waiting for their incoming inspection earn their fee once they pass it.

cost.entriesNone: No charge booked: the fee earned is booked by itself when goods come back.

held.draft: The order is a draft: its work costs nothing until it is sent.
held.cancelled: The order is cancelled: its work costs nothing.
held.server: The order’s state does not allow it now: read it again.
held.isReversal: This entry takes another back: book the cost again instead.
held.takenBack: This entry was taken back already.

book.title: Book a charge on {number}

kindHint.FEE: The fee for pieces back good at the workshop’s price (its invoice, an agreed price): those pieces leave the fee earned, so each piece is paid once.
kindHint.TRANSPORT: Transport to or from the workshop.
kindHint.MATERIAL: Material the workshop supplied and charges for.
kindHint.OTHER: Anything else: say what it is for.

book.question: Book {kind} on {workOrder}?
book.feeOnce_one: {count} piece of line {line} leaves the fee earned: it is paid once.
book.feeOnce_other: {count} pieces of line {line} leave the fee earned: each is paid once.

held.operation: Pick the line whose pieces the fee pays.
held.pieces: A fee pays whole pieces: 1 or more.
held.bookable_one: Line {line} has {count} piece back good whose fee is not booked yet.
held.bookable_other: Line {line} has {count} pieces back good whose fee is not booked yet.
held.quantity: A quantity above 0, at most 4 decimals.
held.price: A price of 0 or more, at most 6 decimals.
held.what: Say what the charge is for.

reverse.title: Take a charge back
reverse.question: Take back {what}?
reverse.once: An entry is taken back once, whole; book the cost again if it is due after all.

held.reason: Say why it is taken back.

refused.entry: This entry cannot be taken back (taken back already, or it takes another back).
refused.operation: Only a fee names a line: pick the line for a fee, none for another charge.
refused.bookable: More pieces than are back good with no fee booked: read the line again.
refused.reason: Say why, in at most 2000 characters.
refused.occurredAt: The cost was incurred now or before, not later.
refused.receipt: That receipt is not one of this order’s.

invoice.title: The workshop’s invoices
invoice.none: No invoice of the workshop names this order yet.
invoice.hint: The match itself is made in Finance › Supplier invoices.

done.booked: Booked: {kind} onto the work order’s cost.
done.reversed: Taken back: the work order’s cost follows.
done.waiting: Booked on the order; the work order’s cost waits (another currency).

ageing.truncated: Days out are read from the newest moves only: filter by workshop to see them all.
ageing.how: Days out count from the oldest part still out (first in, first out); past {days} days a line is long out.

balanceView.intro: Every piece of these jobs is back, but kit material we sent is still out: book it on the order’s Material balance.
balanceView.tableLabel: Jobs back with material still open
balanceView.search: Search order, workshop or work order

empty.title: No balance open
empty.body: Every job back has its material declared: nothing we sent is unaccounted for.
